headline: Firstsource Solutions raises FY27 revenue outlook following strong Q2 profit growth
hook: Stronger growth targets set for FY27
summary: Firstsource Solutions reported a 40.1% sequential rise in net profit for the September quarter, prompting the company to raise its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 10.5%-13%. However, its operating margin narrowed during the same period. Indian retail investors tracking IT and BPO stocks should note the improved medium-term revenue visibility despite margin pressures.

winners_losers: Firstsource shareholders gain / margin-sensitive peers neutral
